description: The message box of a chat. It grows with the text (CSS `field-sizing`, through [`Textarea`](textarea)'s `autosize`), sends with Enter, adds a line with Shift+Enter, and turns Send into Stop while a reply is `busy` (Escape stops too). Sending trims the text, ignores an empty message, empties the box and keeps focus in it. Extra controls (attach, a model picker) go in its children.
name: chat_composer
